page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with short list-like lines. Margin notes in the right margin: "Luna infortuna." beside the line "Infortuna re Lunam", and a second, partly cut note "Luna fortu[?]" beside "Fortificare autem". Running head at top centre. Page number top right. Catchword "In" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: in virgine domicilium habet, & exaltationem simul, unde etiam maxime hoc signo gaudet.
main_text.l: Lunae detrimentum est in capricorno, casus in scorpione.
Porro Luna dicitur fortunare, si fuerit
Obsessa a fortunis, vel radiis earundem.
In bono aspectu Solis, vel aliorum.
main_text.p: Unita Soli, seu in Cazymi. In corde Solis Planeta esse dici-tur, cum fuerit Soli proximus intra 16. minuta ante vel post, id est, cum distat a Sole secundum longitudinem & latitudinem 16. tantum minutis, ut, si Sol esset in 15. gradu cancri, 38. min. Luna similiter in 15. gradu, min. 38. Luna diceretur esse in Cazymi seu corde Solis.
main_text.l: Infortuna re Lunam compertum est, si fueritLuna infortu-na.
Juncta infortunae, vel corpore, vel per radiaturam.
Obsessa ab infortunis, vel radiatura earum.
In malo aspectu Solis vel aliorum.
Juncta stellis fixis maleficis, ut cordi scorpionis in 3. gr. sa-gittarii, capiti Medusae in 23. gr. tauri, &c.
Fortificare autem dicitur, si fueritLuna fortu[?]

page.notes: The first line is a continuation from the previous page. The right-hand note "Luna fortu[?]" is cut off at the margin edge, so its ending is doubtful. The catchword "In" is partly faint. Some words in the list are slightly blurred, and the reading of "opposito" is uncertain: the final letter may be a Cyrillic-looking glyph in the scan and should be checked against the original. The line "Juncta stellis fixis" carries the hyphenated word "sa-gittarii" across the line break.
